candidate.title: SUPeR-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina SUPeR-seq schematic: two parallel RNA substrate examples, poly(A)+ above and poly(A)- below, entering anchored priming, cDNA generation, PCR and purified DNA. They belong to one single-cell RNA assay and are not alternative named workflows. Primary-paper clarification of the T7-primer caption and compressed cDNA chemistry is explicit. The DNA endpoint is interpreted as amplified cDNA at the subsequent TruSeq DNA-library interface; unshown library preparation, sequencing and analysis are described only to explain the readout, without adding operations.
